name: get_recording_status
title: Get recording status
description: Return whether a recording is currently running. `active=false` means no recording is running and every other key is absent. When active, `meeting_id` / `meeting_name` identify the meeting being recorded, `started_at` is the UTC capture start, `elapsed_sec` the seconds recorded so far, and `tracks` maps track name (screen / mic / system) to its file path relative to the bundle. Poll this to render a menu-bar recording indicator; use stop_recording to end the recording. Read-only, takes no arguments. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: internal.

active.description: True while a recording is running. When false, no other key is present.

meeting_name.description: Name of the meeting being recorded.

tracks.description: Track name (screen / mic / system) → file path relative to the bundle (e.g. tracks/mic.m4a).
